motion.name: expressive-ease
motion.purpose: Action fill and arrow transitions; copy reveals.

motion.name: primary-fill
motion.purpose: White hover sweep from the left.

motion.name: copy-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal copy from 24px below with a 5px blur.

motion.name: pose-damping
motion.purpose: Frame-independent smoothing toward the scroll pose.

motion.name: luminous-wipe
motion.value: x = t * 150 - 25 percent; opacity = sin(t * PI)^6 * .75
motion.purpose: Radial mask traverses the atmosphere during chapter interpolation; removed in reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: system preference plus persisted manual override
motion.purpose: Suppress continuous animation, transitions and pointer movement; keep scroll poses and readable content.

motion.name: bottle-orbit
motion.value: drag: 1.5 PI per initial projected width; arrow: PI/12; activation: PI/4
motion.purpose: Explicit 360-degree bottle rotation, with native vertical touch scrolling and keyboard reset.

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:39px}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:12px 0;font:11px Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#bbb8cb;text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s}.ds-nav a:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:#eee6ff;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#fff}.ds-nav a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #dfd2ff;outline-offset:7px}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-nav{gap:20px}.ds-nav a{font-size:9px}.ds-nav a:first-child{display:none}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a,.ds-nav a:after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: The pinned visual world joins luxury perfume photography with cosmic space: black, blue, violet and cold silver; smoked glass, restrained text and thin luminous orbits. The product remains the visual anchor while oversized serif lettering and quiet interface marks establish scale.
keyCharacteristics: Large, light serif type with compact sans-serif controls.
Sparse copy, generous space and continuous atmospheric depth.
dos: Do keep the black, blue, violet and cold-silver world.
Do reserve the largest serif type for product identity and short headlines.
Do preserve native scrolling, anchor navigation and the reduced-motion control.
Do keep the conceptual bottle and all product wording honest about available evidence.
donts: Don't add unsupported scent notes, concentration, pricing or purchase destinations.
Don't turn atmospheric light colors into large opaque interface panels.
Don't introduce dense cards or heavy rounded controls into this sparse composition.
